name: Icelandic Nationals 2021
information: Velkomin! Ef þetta er fyrsta skipti sem þið eruð að keppa gerir WCA kröfu um **löggild skilríki** í skráningarferlinu. Það er að segja vegabréf, ökuskírteini eða nafnskírteini. *ATH: ekki nægir að koma með debitkort!* If this is your first time competing you must bring **official identification** as it is required for registration with the WCA. This means passport, driver's licence or other official ID. *Note: Payment cards are not official ID!* Vinsamlegast lesið upplýsingarnar undir [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IcelandicNationals2021#16925-covid-19) flipanum! Hlutir sem ber að hafa í huga áður en mætt er til keppninnar: Haltu þig heima og skráðu þig strax í PCR-sýnatöku hjá Heilsuveru ef þú finnur til einkenna/veikinda. Það er grímuskylda inni í salnum. Einungis 1 gestur fyrir hvern keppanda. Komdu með þinn eigin penna. **LESTU [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IcelandicNationals2021#16925-covid-19) FLIPANN FYRIR FREKARI UPPLÝSINGAR!** Takk fyrir! Please read the [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IcelandicNationals2021#16925-covid-19) information tab! Things to consider before going to the competition: Stay at home and sign up for PCR-testing at Heilsuvera if you are feeling ill or are experiencing symptoms. Only 1 guest per competitor. Mask use is mandatory. Bring your own pen. **READ THE [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IcelandicNationals2021#16925-covid-19) TAB FOR MORE INFORMATION!** Thank you!
